main_text.p: xuriant, plusquam ipsi indigenæ in eloquium effrænes. Honora-rium est istud verber, mi Belgica: Pectore excipias aut cavo latere, ut sonet, & testetur sub artubus robur: Ne te pudeat, ne diffiteare: Virago es pariter cum Germanica lingua; sed tamen sofrore, vel (ut quidam volunt) matre tuâ placidior: Admittit, ut suademus: & ultro insultans: At Latina lingua, inquit, mollis & effæminata: Vix ultra duas Consonantes proferre valet sine fulcro Vocalis: Blæsa etiam est, & balbutit, frequenti ejusdem syllabæ geminatione: audi balbutiem in exemplo: Quid de re mererere? Quid de re rere rara? jactat faber fecisse sese securim: Hoc amplius, quia ultimam syllabam Latina lingua non producit, in qua tamen Nominum ac Verborum Declinationes constituit,

page.notes: Faint show-through from the facing page is visible at the left edge and in the upper margin; not transcribed. Printed text reads "fo-rore" with the long-s forms as printed; "sofrore" is a transcription of "fo-rore" split across the line end, and should read "sonorore" only if the scan confirms it; the word at this line end is "fo-" with "rore" following. Heading of the page is the running head only.
